title: Compute the radical and components of the second jet of xyz

source.citation: Federico Galetto and Nicholas P. Iammarino, Computing with jets, arXiv:2108.06350

translation.notes: The three jet coefficients are expanded directly from x(t)y(t)z(t) modulo t^3. Noether certifies the published ten-generator squarefree radical and its ten minimal primes. A general jet-scheme constructor and local component multiplicities remain outside this case.
